_note: Daily audio brief (ElevenLabs text-to-speech). voiceId is the custom 'Waynesville News' voice. modelId: eleven_multilingual_v2 (more natural; about 1 credit per character) — with a 30,000-credit monthly plan that allows roughly 1,000 characters (about a minute) a day. eleven_flash_v2_5 costs about half as much but sounds flatter. maxChars hard-caps each script so a long day can't overrun the plan. voiceSettings are passed to ElevenLabs: lower stability = more expressive, style adds delivery. minCreditsLeft: skip the day (don't fail) if fewer credits remain (needs the key's User: Read permission). enabled: false until the daily pipeline is switched on. The API key lives only in the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY repository secret.
